 Doc’s Seafood Shack – Foley, Alabama
 Fresh. Hot. Gulf Coast Good.

 

 Seafood, steaks, big portions, and a laid-back Gulf Coast vibe. 

 
 At Doc’s Seafood Shack in Foley, we’ve been serving locals and visitors for decades with bold flavor and classic coastal favorites. From fried shrimp and oyster platters to hearty steaks and house specialties, every plate delivers the kind of Southern dining experience people come back for—hot, satisfying, and made to order.
 

 
 Start with chargrilled oysters or seafood gumbo, then dive into jumbo shrimp, golden oysters, or one of our house favorites served with hushpuppies and slaw. Feeling bold? Pair a juicy steak with Gulf shrimp for the best of both worlds.
 

 
 Big portions, fair prices, and service that makes you feel at home—that’s why folks keep coming back to Doc’s.

 Frequently Asked Questions

Doc’s Seafood Foley FAQs

 Hours, ordering, menu details, and everything you need to know before you visit.

 (251) 334-2888
 View FAQs

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 What kind of food does Doc’s Seafood Shack serve?
 
 Doc’s serves Gulf Coast seafood, steaks, and Southern classics including fried shrimp, oysters, seafood platters, gumbo, and hearty house favorites made fresh to order.
 
 

 
 Do you offer pickup and delivery?
 
 Yes. Doc’s Seafood Shack offers both pickup and delivery options so you can enjoy your meal at home or on the go.
 
 

 
 Where is Doc’s Seafood Shack located?
 
 Doc’s Seafood Shack is located at 20520 Miflin Rd., Foley, Alabama. It’s a local favorite for seafood and casual coastal dining.
 
 

 
 What are your most popular menu items?
 
 Customer favorites include fried shrimp, seafood platters, gumbo, oysters, and steak and shrimp combinations. Big portions and bold flavor are what keep people coming back.
 
 

 
 Do you serve steaks as well as seafood?
 
 Yes. In addition to seafood, Doc’s offers steaks and combination plates so guests can enjoy both Gulf flavors and classic steakhouse favorites.
 
 

 
 Can I view the menu online?
 
 Yes. You can view the full menu online before visiting or placing an order to see all available seafood, steaks, and Southern dishes.
 
 

 
 Do you offer gift cards?
 
 Yes. Doc’s gift cards are available and make a great option for birthdays, holidays, and special occasions.
 
 

 
 What are your hours?
 
 Hours may vary by day. For the most accurate and current hours, please call the restaurant directly or check online before visiting.
